Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! Our beautiful custom jewellery can reach you almost anywhere in the world. For customs and duties, here’s how it works:

For most European countries, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, a 30% tariff applies to purchases due to new regulations, and these charges are the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges or import duties are set by your local authorities and will need to be paid by you. We don’t cover these charges, so it’s a good idea to check with your local customs office if you want to avoid surprises.
